en: What do we wear on our feet before shoes?
We put socks on our feet before our shoes.
What do we wear on our hands when it is cold?
What do we wrap around our neck?
A scarf goes around our neck to keep it warm.
What do we wear on our head?
A hat goes on our head.
What do we wear to bed?
We wear pyjamas when we go to sleep.
What do we wear over our clothes when it is cold outside?
A coat keeps us warm outside.
What do we wear to go swimming?
We wear a swimsuit in the water.
What do we wear on our feet to walk outside?
Shoes protect our feet when we walk.
What do we wear on top, with sleeves?
A jumper is a warm top with sleeves.
What do we wear on our feet inside the house?
Slippers are soft shoes for indoors.
What do we wear around our waist to hold up trousers?
A belt holds our trousers up.
What do we wear in the rain to keep dry?
A raincoat keeps the rain off.
What do we wear over our eyes in bright sun?
Sunglasses protect our eyes from bright sun.
What do we wear on our feet in the snow?
Warm boots keep our feet dry in the snow.

example.q_en: What do we wear on our feet before shoes?
example.why_en: We put socks on our feet before our shoes.

en.title: Clothes
en.teach: We wear different clothes on different parts of the body: a hat on our head, socks on our feet, gloves on our hands.
